subject: geography

items.q: How do you read a grid reference on an OS map?
items.correct: Eastings first, then northings ('along the corridor, up the stairs').
items.why: Eastings (across) come before northings (up); contour lines show height, not position.

items.q: What do contour lines that are close together show?
items.correct: Steep ground — the closer the lines, the steeper the slope.
items.why: Contours join points of equal height; tightly packed contours mean a steep gradient.
